results.summary: NFR-S01 ask invariant holds in table and renderer; NFR-S02 holds for the gate

noveltyJustification: no new findings; four security surfaces were ruled out with file:line evidence and the two hardening reads were recorded as edge cases

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: security pass over a prompt-to-brief trust boundary with two runtime copies

omittedHighRiskTargets: daemon transport and MCP bridge were not read; they are outside the reviewed scope files

searchLedger.hypothesis: a /deep:* command can render with run policy

searchActions.result: both deep commands are ask; the renderer offer branch requires ask

searchLedger.hypothesis: the advisor forwards credentials to its child

searchActions.result: the child inherits process.env, as a normal child does; the gate reads only the prompt

searchLedger.rationale: ordinary inheritance, not a credential read; NFR-S02 is about what the advisor reads and writes
